findings.title: Incorrect sign and omitted normalization in Stokes directional derivative
findings.claimed: c_in^d=+I/(2*pi*i*mu3); Lemma 11.5 further equates c_in^d with I.
findings.suspect_step: Differentiating +mu*Delta in (11.6) yields Lpsi=-Delta, opposite (11.9). Wronskian for unstable-minus-stable is -I.
findings.verified_result: c_in^d=-I/(2*pi*i*mu3). For real D=tan(sqrt(2)u/4)^5*(1+tan(...)^2) in F1, I(D)=-26*pi^2/15, correct c(D)=-13*pi*i/(30*sqrt(2)); printed sign gives its negative.
hypothesis_check: D real, odd, O(u^5); nearest pole sqrt(2)*pi>1, so D belongs F1
Contour sufficiently low stays in analytic domain
Delta0=-iD used only in complexified space; return to real admissible D
findings.complete_verification: English report Section 3 contains differentiated equation, integration by parts, both endpoint signs, asymptotic normalization, explicit homogeneous solution, moment integral, residue, real-direction conversion and repair boundary.
counterevidence: Changing parameter or labels would alter fixed definitions, not repair current formula
Corrected derivative is nonzero, preserving genericity input
Real odd polynomial approximants provide nonzero direction in any Fr using analytic continuity and normalized inner-solution uniqueness
findings.core_impact: Local quantitative Stokes formula incorrect; no demonstrated failure of generic nonvanishing, splitting order, or single-bump nonexistence.
findings.repair: Change (11.9) to Lpsi+Delta=0; negative prefactor in (11.13); distinguish raw integral from normalized derivative in Lemma 11.5.
findings.repair_boundary: Local correction verified, retaining Section 5 analytic construction. Does not certify the complete proof.

acceptance_corrections: Corrected the source locator Proposition11.3 to Lemma11.3, and removed wording implying that a fresh whole-paper reconstruction is required for focused acceptance. Minor is retained because the exact nonvanishing predicate used by genericity is preserved by the nonzero scalar correction.

independent_acceptance_check.scope: Focused independent acceptance of the existing Stokes-derivative sign/normalization Problem in the exact acquired arXiv:2107.14566v3 file. No journal-version equivalence, new Problem search or full reconstruction of the paper's invariant-manifold estimates is asserted.

checks.result: With the paper's fixed parameter and unstable-minus-stable conventions, differentiation gives L psi=-Delta, the Wronskian derivative is minus the forcing integral, and the difference satisfies W(psi^u-psi^s)=-I. Hence the derivative is -I/(2*pi*i*mu_3), rather than the printed signed/unnormalized identification.

The existing exact symbolic calculation and its source hypotheses were checked without rerunning unchanged code. The real analytic direction in F_1 has I=-26*pi^2/15 and corrected derivative -13*pi*i/(30*sqrt(2)), which is nonzero. The source locator has been corrected from Proposition 11.3 to Lemma 11.3.

The correction is multiplication by a fixed nonzero scalar at the relevant linear-functional level, preserving the kernel and nonvanishing input used by genericity. The polynomial approximation transfer to other radius spaces remains conditional on the Section 5 analytic construction. Minor is supported by this explicit preserved dependency, not merely by the ease of repair; no false leading splitting order or false single-bump theorem is established.

The report now separates the completed focused acceptance from any future full reconstruction of invariant-manifold and matching estimates. Human adjudication remains pending and no author adoption is claimed.

independent_acceptance_check.result: Accepted after correction of the Lemma 11.3 locator and acceptance-scope wording. The single existing Problem remains Minor; zero Major Problems are established.
